notes.title: Face off against the most fierce guardian of the ruins this Christmas Eve!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40776255/68568325f1904b9025e01babe326e7471e28c616.gif[/img]

Check out the brand new addition to Death Realm, the [b]Cave Ruins from the Abyss![/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40776255/ce7034c3a4d88f7006cb7604656d560ee72c3606.png[/img]


Don't forget to keep your headphones on for the best Death Realm Experience! Thanks to the improvements to the sound system and a wide variety of beautiful orchestral music! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40776255/befd8f604e77d72fc10d4cb8ddacc76ef35d87f9.png[/img]


Face off against the brand new Boss, [b]The Ruin Guardian![/b] A Drake guarding the ruin treasure for eons, no one escaped its jaws and the breath of fire~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40776255/02828912f12181400b34f04ae30a9b6f4695bc8b.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40776255/be0c637cd467eab133b319a9ae52ae2c407073df.png[/img]





Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!

Don't forget to check out our Socials updates, events and sneak peaks of the game!

notes.title: Face your nightmares with the brand new addition to Death Realm!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40776255/95fd7d20b270f049be592ac7b1385101b87de11b.png[/img]

[b][h3]Like a dream...[/h3][/b]


Face the hoardes of creatures, born from the abyss and raised from the dead, Explore the streets and unravel the secrets, be warned though! Death lies in every corner...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40776255/419cc729397122ed4db5ada5c6eb33d58755efca.png[/img]


Enter the castle and face off against the first Lord, bound to flames and steel. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40776255/824a1cc5308ba6b2ff0cedc0923e69c7d0d477a7.png[/img]
